WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(spent) as avg_spent,
    AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
global_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) as mean_remaining
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT 
  link_to_event,
  avg_spent,
  avg_remaining,
  (avg_remaining - (SELECT mean_remaining FROM global_mean)) as difference
FROM event_averages
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
